messages:
maya: Morning folks — starting my first on-call rotation next week and want to make sure I don't miss anything. Quick Qs: who runs the shadow checklist, how do I join the next incident sim, and I still don't see PagerDuty in my apps (if anyone can confirm access). @ravi?

ravi: Hey @maya — just checked, you weren't in the PD schedule yet. I added you and triggered an invite; check spam if you don't see it. Shadow checklist lives in the runbooks repo under oncall/shadow-checklist.md. If you want, I can escalate vault read access for the creds.

alex: I can take a buddy slot Tue morning 09:00-09:45. We usually do a quick golden-path walk: receive alert -> initial triage -> quick mitigation -> hand it back. We'll do a mini mock so you get hands-on. :+1:

sam: Signups for sims are on the form: https://go/rw-oncall-sims. Put your GitHub handle in the comment. Heads-up: we prefer folks try the local reenact before the sim so it flows.

lee: Also subscribe to #incidents-watcher for read-only play-by-play during shadow week. Good to see the message patterns and channel etiquette.

maya: Thanks — the runbook is pretty terse. Is there a boiled-down pre-shadow checklist I can run through tonight?

alex: Yep — quick starter list I run with new folks: 
1) Verify PagerDuty login and enable mobile notifications (do a low-priority test page).
2) Confirm access to runbooks and vault (read-only).
3) Run local reenact script to trigger an alert in dev cluster.
4) Read one recent postmortem to see expected notes.

alex: Local reenact snippet from runbooks:
```bash
# deploy a load generator to repro a CPU spike on dev
kubectl apply -f tools/load-gen.yaml -n dev-test
sleep 20
# tail logs to watch behavior
kubectl logs -f deploy/load-gen -n dev-test
```

ravi: If you need vault access, file an infra-access request with justification; mark it as "oncall-shadow" and I'll expedite. Important: never use prod creds during sims.

oncall-coordinator: @maya added to shadow cohort starting 2026-06-01 and assigned alex as your buddy. Reserved sim slot Wed 2026-06-02 14:00-15:00. Reminder: complete the orientation checklist here before shadow: https://go/rw-oncall-checklist

maya: One operational question: if I actually get a page during shadow, what's the escalation ladder in practice? Short bullets would help.

lee: Escalation TL;DR: 
- 0-15m: Own first response — ack in PD, post initial context in #incidents, start timeline in incident doc.
- 15-35m: If not resolved, escalate to the secondary PD contact and @oncall-lead in the channel.
- 35-60m: If impact is >P1 or affects customers, call the on-call lead and start an incident channel using the template.
- Post-incident: Assign postmortem owner within 48h and add action items to the tracking board.

sam: We'll run a short live drill during your shadow so you can practice escalation and writing the running doc. No surprises. :muscle:

maya: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll fill out the sim form and try the reenact tonight. Appreciate the help!

sre-bot: Rotation updated: maya added to PagerDuty rotation week starting 2026-06-01. Notifications sent to maya, alex, ravi.
